claim: Let p be an odd prime and let \(\kappa_1,\ldots,\kappa_r\in H^1_{\mathrm{et}}(U,\mu_p)\) be independent coordinate Kummer classes. For an integer exponent matrix \(A\in\mathbb Z^{s\times r}\), the classes \(\alpha_i=\sum_j a_{ij}\kappa_j\) arising from Tate parameters \(q_i=p^p\prod_j T_j^{a_{ij}}\) all vanish after a finite étale monomial cover with exponent matrix \(M\) exactly when \(\bar A\bar M=0\); the least possible cover degree is \(p^{\operatorname{rank}_{\mathbb F_p}(\bar A)}\).

correctness.rationale: Under the independent-coordinate-class assumption, Kummer pullback gives the matrix equation A-bar M-bar=0. Its rank forces p^rho to divide every admissible determinant, and the adapted-basis construction attains degree p^rho. All cases and the monomial-cover restriction are explicit.

value.rationale: The rank is the exact number of independent coordinate Kummer directions that must be ramified by p. It distinguishes repeated exponent rows, which share a degree-p cover, from independent directions requiring higher degree; this is a natural minimal-cost invariant for simultaneous normal-crossings degenerations.
